contract: After a streaming cover search's providers have all settled, CoverSearchManager calls onComplete only when its AbortController was not aborted, and SocketAuthority emits cover_search_complete with the single argument {requestId} to the requesting socket alone. One event is emitted per search, after that search's cover_search_result events. A search that produced no covers, a provider failure and a swallowed custom-provider HTTP failure still complete; a cancelled or rejected search never completes.
exceptions: force is not applicable: a search has no force or override mode, so there is no separate complete variant to exercise.

invariants.contract: One search_covers emits exactly one cover_search_complete to the requesting socket and none to another connection of the same user, another user's socket or an unauthenticated socket. The argument is exactly {requestId} and it arrives after that search's cover_search_result events. Each further search emits its own complete, including a requestId reused after its previous search completed. A search whose provider returned no covers still completes exactly once with no result, a search for a provider row that was deleted before it ran still completes, and a finder-level provider failure emits cover_search_provider_error and then completes with no result. A search rejected for missing parameters or an unauthenticated socket emits cover_search_error and no complete, and a cancelled search never completes.
